hero.headline: Framer vs Squarespace
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.best_for_a: Framer is best for designers and teams who want pixel-perfect control, advanced animations, and the ability to prototype and ship with one tool.
summary.best_for_b: Squarespace is best for small businesses and creators who want an all-in-one, beginner-friendly site with elegant templates and straightforward commerce features.
summary.quick_take: Framer gives designers unrivaled control over layout, interactions, and modern CSS-driven visuals, making it ideal for custom, high-conversion landing pages and interactive portfolio sites. Squarespace focuses on ease and speed, offering curated templates, reliable hosting, and built-in ecommerce that helps non-technical users launch quickly. Choose Framer when design fidelity and animation matter; choose Squarespace when you need a polished site with minimal setup.

paragraphs: Picking the right website builder shapes how quickly you can launch, how your brand looks, and how easily you can convert visitors. Framer and Squarespace target different needs: Framer leans into design and interactivity, while Squarespace packages usability and commerce.

This comparison highlights the areas that matter for conversions—design flexibility, load speed, SEO basics, ecommerce, and setup time—so you can choose the builder that reduces friction and drives results for your project.

data.headline: Framer for custom design, Squarespace for simplicity
data.summary: If your priority is advanced design control, modern animations, and a flexible canvas, Framer wins. If you want a fast-to-launch, maintenance-light site with built-in commerce and templates that just work, Squarespace is the smarter pick.

items.question: Which builder is faster to launch with no prior experience?
items.answer: Squarespace is generally faster for beginners thanks to its template-first approach, all-in-one hosting, and guided editor.

items.question: Can I export code or migrate easily between the two?
items.answer: Framer produces modern code and offers exportable assets, but direct migration between platforms usually requires rebuilding templates and layouts to match each system's structure.

items.question: Which platform is better for SEO?
items.answer: Both handle basic SEO well; Framer gives more control for advanced optimizations, while Squarespace offers reliable built-in SEO tools and fast hosting for most use cases.

items.question: Is ecommerce robust on both platforms?
items.answer: Squarespace has mature built-in ecommerce suited for most small businesses; Framer supports commerce through integrations but is less feature-rich out of the box.

items.question: Which one helps improve conversions out of the box?
items.answer: Squarespace provides conversion-oriented templates and simple commerce flows immediately, while Framer enables higher conversion potential through custom design and tailored interactions when you invest the time.
